premise.text: The songs should be read as one coherent journey, the story of discovering what forms are possible, what topologies, what spaces, bodies, organizational structures and their edges.

about: The whole tower as one story, kept abstract: eight acts, one movement for each spine sequence, one stop for each floor. A stop says what it takes from the stop before and what it discovers, names which of the six words it is about, and touches two or more entries of the trajectory outline in the order the outline gives them. It is a frame for the songs and not their text: a lyric is still written from the player's view of the floor, and checked there. Nothing here was heard or walked for this document; every stop is read from the floor's intent and its outline entries. Palle, 19 November 2026: the songs are very compressed, and that is how a song shows intelligence: by folding (Dichtung). A line compresses the meaning of the artifact and of the encounter without losing it. So what stands on the floor and what was measured there is kept in the notes under a line ("seen", "unfolded"), and the line itself is the fold: at most twelve words. Each floor has a chapter, commons/maps/<map>/final.md, written in Model B's voice with the encounters in order; read it before writing a line. Act one was first written without it and was corrected on 19 November: for every sung line the chapter's section on that encounter was read, and twenty-nine lines changed. The chapters were not read end to end, and they were written around the Endless Museum: the meaning is taken from the chapter, the facts from the floor as it stands. Palle, 19 November: take in all ideas and pick the best one. For the first sequence every line another session had written for the same encounter was laid beside mine and the better one taken: sixteen of the forty-three lines are theirs. The one-word chain between songs is kept where it still holds and is no longer required. Palle, 19 November: the new text for a floor is commons/maps/<map>/void.md, and final.md stays as it is, as the reference. Write and revise in void.md; read final.md.

Not developed yet. A first form of it: every song keeps one word from the song before and uses it for something new, and every stop leaves one thing she takes with her. The game happens before book one. In the Service novels (Residue, Threshold, Pending) five units keep their posts: a gate agent, a vice-consul, an architectural drafter, a night nurse, a farmhand. Among them comes a visitor nobody names, in a dry coat, with a fold of repair tape on the third finger of her left hand. She sits, she does not speak, and she leaves a mark. That visitor is Model B (Palle confirmed it on 19 November 2026). So what a stop hands on is written here as a sentence but has to reach a unit as a gesture or as a thing left behind, and no song may tell a reader of the novels who she is. Where a stop already has an echo in the books it is noted under the stop. At the end of an act the sentences are gathered into four lines, one for each movement.
